name: towns-diner-pos
description: Towns — a Japanese-inspired, offline-first restaurant POS.

scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web -w @towns/desktop
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate -w @towns/server && npm run build -w @towns/server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,pos -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @towns/server" "npm run dev -w @towns/desktop"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @towns/server
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @towns/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @towns/shared && npm run typecheck -w @towns/server && npm run typecheck -w @towns/desktop
